chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام said:

O group of those who have not performed hajj, rejoice at the pilgrims when they return; shake hands with them and honor them, for that is incumbent upon you, so that you may share with them in the reward.

key_terms.بِالْحَاجِّ: regarding the pilgrim; the one who performed hajj
key_terms.يَا مَعْشَرَ: O assembly; a direct address to a group of people

ai.seo_question: How should Muslims welcome pilgrims returning from hajj?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام instructs those who have not gone for hajj to welcome returning pilgrims with joy, greeting, and honor. The hadith teaches communal reverence for acts of worship and shows that honoring the people of devotion becomes a means of sharing in spiritual reward.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2264 - Imam Ali ibn Al-Husayn (as) said:

"O group of those who have not performed Hajj, rejoice in the arrival of the pilgrims when they return. Greet them with handshakes and honor them, for this is an obligation upon you, and by doing so, you will share in their reward."
